headline.text: L1 caramel depositor has been down since *01:15* with foreign material found in the reserve tank — origin still under investigation at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran pecan cluster through the day with a changeover at midday and hit 24,480 pouches by 23:28. Two resolved machine issues: a scraper causing chocolate buildup (cleared in 18 minutes) and a temper pause (cleared in 16 minutes). Overnight, the caramel depositor went down at 01:15 and a soft plastic foreign material was found in the reserve tank at 01:20 — maintenance couldn't determine the origin and the search continues.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 and ML4 both completed level 2 clean on schedule. ML4 had unfilled bars slipping past de-molding despite marked molds — the checkweigh caught them and the team was coached. A Sweco screen was shredded when an operator turned on the wrong unit during reassembly; the screen was replaced and cleaning continued. Minor material shortage on blue shrink wrap, workaround in place.

resolved.title: Scraper not in position causing chocolate buildup on rollers
resolved.summary: A loose scraper was sticking downward and caused chocolate to build up on rollers, nearly pulling an air line into the roller before the line was stopped.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:33 — "We resume production" (Francisco Gudino Torres). Scraper repositioned and line restarted after 18 minutes.

resolved.title: Line paused for temper adjustment
resolved.summary: Sollich 3 paused at 17:41 to wait for two tempers before restarting; ran accumulation while waiting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:59 — "Line resuming temper is good" and "Line resume production" (S3 Enrober, Francisco Gudino Torres). Temper came back in spec after 16 minutes.

resolved.title: Proximity sensors missing, line equipment not working
resolved.summary: William Lopez found replacement proximity sensors and installed them, restoring full function.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:47 — "Luckily I found some proximity sensors and installed them. Everything is working fine now" (William Lopez).

resolved.title: Sweco screen shredded during ML4 clean
resolved.summary: An operator set a Sweco screen on a disassembled unit then turned on the wrong Sweco during testing, shredding the screen; operator coached on LOTO and food-contact surface handling.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:16 — "New Sweco screen for south side passed ATP" (Daniel McCarty). Replacement screen washed and installed, lock placed on Sweco.

resolved.title: C6 belt moved south side on ML1
resolved.summary: The C6 conveyor belt shifted south during production; maintenance was notified.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:55 — "New belt on C 6 has been installed" (Jose Vasquez). Belt replaced during level 2 clean.

resolved.title: Imperial water jacket temperature too high
resolved.summary: ML1 Imperial water jacket rose above acceptable range during production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:03 — "Adjustment made to get out of yellow" (Imperial). Shawn Jewkes confirmed it's acceptable as long as temper stays solid.

resolved.title: Machine keys missing from ML1
resolved.summary: Imperial depositor keys were missing during the shift.

needs_attention.title: Caramel depositor down on Sollich 3
needs_attention.summary: The caramel depositor stopped working; line is running product already in the tunnels but cannot deposit new product.
needs_attention.status: Line down on depositor as of 01:15, running existing tunnel inventory. No further updates by window close.

needs_attention.title: Foreign material found in Sollich 3 reserve tank
needs_attention.summary: Soft plastic material (appears to be a seal or gasket) was discovered in the caramel reserve tank during a verification check; candy shipment to deposit suspended, tank drained, and FM separated for evaluation.
needs_attention.status: FM identified and removed at 01:20. Maintenance could not determine origin; Luis Falcon continuing search as of 01:24. No resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: Insufficient staffing for Sollich 4 cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Level 2 cleaning of lanes 10–17 and Theegarten was completed, but the rest of the line was left undone due to staffing shortages.
needs_attention.status: Partial clean completed at 22:33; remainder of line not cleaned. No follow-up plan stated in window.

needs_attention.title: Unfilled bars slipping past de-molding on ML4
needs_attention.summary: Checkweigh scales rejected caddies due to low weight; unfilled bars were found even though molds were marked and two people were stationed at de-molding.
needs_attention.status: Unfilled bars identified and removed at 13:41. Preston coached de-molding team at 13:46 to keep close watch and cover breaks. No further rejects reported, but ongoing vigilance required.

needs_attention.title: Chocolate pallet inventory discrepancy on Truffle Line
needs_attention.summary: A pallet of chocolate (Item 10257, LPN R344375) was present at the start of inventory on September 11–12 but missing by the end; appears to have been consumed without being recorded in the system.
needs_attention.status: Fredy reported at 11:29 that the pallet was consumed at the beginning of the shift and will proceed with inventory adjustment. Adjustment not yet confirmed.

needs_attention.title: Missing bolt on ML4 depositor 2 nozzle plate
needs_attention.summary: An operator noticed a bolt is missing from the nozzle plate on depositor 2 during cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Shane reported at 14:54 he will call maintenance when reassembling to get another bolt. No follow-up confirmation that bolt was replaced.

needs_attention.title: Out of blue shrink wrap on ML1
needs_attention.summary: ML1 ran out of blue allergen shrink wrap; WHS team not in on the weekend.
needs_attention.status: Workaround at 22:42: wrapping partial supersack with clear wrap and labeling as Allergen. No restock plan by window close.

needs_attention.title: Hydraulic cylinder on ML1 mold heater lid needs replacement
needs_attention.summary: An employee is using a wrench to hold up the south-side mold heater lid because the hydraulic cylinder has failed.
needs_attention.status: Kimberly asked Chad Stone at 03:06 if replacement has been ordered. No response by window close.
